hook: Hugo Touvron holds two bachelor's degrees, from Ecole Polytechnique and Paris Dauphine University, and three master's degrees in mathematics and computer science from Ecole Polytechnique, ENS Paris-Saclay, and ENSTA ParisTech. He joined Facebook AI Research in November 2019 as a resident PhD student advised by Herve Jegou at Facebook and Matthieu Cord at Sorbonne University, where his early work centered on data-efficient image transformers and vision transfer learning, including the DeiT and DeiT III papers. He then moved into large language models, becoming lead author of LLaMA, Meta's open-weights foundation language model released in February 2023, followed by Llama 2 in July 2023 and a contribution to Code Llama in August 2023. His work helped establish the open-weights LLaMA family as a widely used alternative to closed frontier models.
